crossRefs.note: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be…
If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

translations.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
translations.bsb: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
translations.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
translations.asv: Ye have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
